description: This file defines functions and types for creating various LINE messaging templates such as confirm, button, carousel, and image carousel templates, as well as converting payloads into these templates. It also exports actions and types related to LINE messaging.

methods.name: buildTemplatePayloadAction
methods.description: Constructs an Action object based on the provided TemplatePayloadAction, choosing uriAction, postbackAction, or messageAction accordingly.

methods.name: createConfirmTemplate
methods.description: Creates a confirm template message with yes/no options.

methods.name: createButtonTemplate
methods.description: Creates a button template message with title, text, and action buttons.

methods.name: createTemplateCarousel
methods.description: Creates a carousel template message with multiple columns.

methods.name: createCarouselColumn
methods.description: Creates a carousel column object for use in carousel templates.

methods.name: createImageCarousel
methods.description: Creates an image carousel template message.

methods.name: createImageCarouselColumn
methods.description: Creates an image carousel column object.

methods.name: createYesNoConfirm
methods.description: Creates a yes/no confirmation dialog as a template message.

methods.name: createButtonMenu
methods.description: Creates a button menu with text buttons.

methods.name: createLinkMenu
methods.description: Creates a button menu with URL links.

methods.name: createProductCarousel
methods.description: Creates a product/item carousel template message.

methods.name: buildTemplateMessageFromPayload
methods.description: Converts a LineTemplateMessagePayload into a LINE TemplateMessage.
